- New radio: NFC, with a reader, writer, copy, erase and lock, bank card reader, memory dump and antenna test. It now comes before SDR in the list
- New SDR tools: CubeSat telemetry, DECT base stations, DSC maritime calls, FLARM, ISM sensors, LoRaWAN / Sigfox, PMR446 (FM, DMR and dPMR with voice), VDL Mode 2 and Wireless M-Bus, plus POCSAG and TPMS
- POCSAG, TPMS, VDL Mode 2 and Wireless M-Bus are greyed out for now with "Coming soon": they are still being reviewed
- SDR: automatic gain, on by default in every tool
- ACARS: the demodulator is rewritten and mends a bad character with the block checksum
- ADS-B: Mode A/C replies, and one or two uncertain bits are mended for aircraft already heard
- AIS: bytes are read least significant bit first, as the standard says
- APRS and CubeSat: the receiver follows the sender's bit clock and takes frames of any size
- DECT: the R-CRC and the RFPI fields are fixed. DSC: telecommands 121 (ship position) and 103 (polling) were swapped
- FLARM: the frame CRC is fixed, and the protocol FLARM moved to in 2024 (V7) is decoded
- ISM: Lidl Auriol, Hideki, Ecowitt WH31 and more Oregon Scientific sensors
- LoRaWAN: network names from the LoRa Alliance's NetID table, and an option to listen to all eight EU868 uplink channels
- Meteor-M: the satellites that now transmit with offset QPSK (Meteor-M2-x, 137.900 MHz) can be received
- PMR446: dPMR is fixed to the ETSI standard (error correction, scrambling, end of call), and its voice is no longer descrambled by mistake
- Radiosondes: Horus amateur balloons
- Drones: analogue video no longer rolls, and RC links survive lost buffers
